lastFeature: Offline support (Feature lane, v0.5.45) -- COMPLETE through all 9 Weft stages and COMMITTED to main on the VM (NOT yet released). Made SnowRaven usable offline: Tier A (tuned vector style persisted via the storage seam + seeded before any network fetch so maps mount offline and draw the user's data layers); opt-in desktop-only region downloads (PMTiles served to MapLibre via a custom srpm:// protocol over true range reads); weather/tide replay (opt-in per call-site, separate from the 90s networkCache); a bundled eBird taxonomy snapshot as the offline floor in BOTH runtimes; three-state offline/no-key/server-error messaging incl. the web/Pi backend-down distinction (FR-39a) and the update-check 404 fix; and a generic /settings/{key} store. Found+fixed a latent rewriteStyleAssetUrls glyph-token percent-encoding bug. 1094 frontend + 157 backend tests green; security review clean (no Critical/High). Release.sh + the release-time map assets are Mac-only -- see remainingBacklog + pipeline/offline-support/release-runbook.md.
remainingBacklog: OFFLINE-SUPPORT RELEASE (Mac-only; v0.5.45 is committed to main but NOT released): follow pipeline/offline-support/release-runbook.md. Decide full-feature (capture+bundle glyphs/sprite under frontend/public/mapassets; bake county/state PMTiles via tools/build-regions -> upload to a regions-2026.06 GitHub Releases tag; populate frontend/src/assets/regions-catalog.json via gen-catalog.mjs; flip BUNDLED_MAP_ASSETS=true in frontend/src/lib/mapStyle.ts) vs resilience-only (ship as-is now, regions/labels in a later version). Then commit any asset changes -> push the v0.5.45 tag (starts Windows CI) -> wait for CI -> `zsh -lc ./release.sh`. STANDING RELEASE NOTE: release.sh runs only on the Mac (Apple signing creds are exported only in the Mac LOGIN profile; a bare ./release.sh fails preflight with APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY is not set). STANDING tag-re-push guard after any tag re-push: confirm the most-recent successful windows-build.yml run headSha == tag commit. The bundled eBird taxonomy snapshot is already generated + committed (frontend/src/assets/ebird-taxonomy.json + backend/staticdata/ebird_taxonomy.json); its version key and the desktop IndexedDB CACHE_KEY advance in lockstep. Known minor deferred: computeLocationsSorted (speciesStats.ts) groups by location NAME keeping first-seen locId; region-manifest reads are intentionally uncoalesced (a small file mutated mid-session, where fresh reads are correct).
